description: Defines data structures and classes for struct-of-arrays table representation, including row and column views, table management, and row ID handling in the ocudu::soa namespace.

classes.name: row_view
classes.description: Provides a view of a row in a struct-of-arrays table, allowing access to cells by column enum or type.

classes.name: column_view
classes.description: Provides a view of a column in the table, supporting access by row ID and iteration.

classes.name: table
classes.description: Represents a struct-of-arrays table with methods for insertion, deletion, and access of rows and columns.

methods.name: nof_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the table.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the table has no rows.

methods.name: has_row_id
methods.description: Checks if a row with the given row ID exists.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses a cell in a specific column and row ID.

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Returns the internal offset for a given row ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new row with provided values and returns its row ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a row by row ID or iterator.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all data from the table.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Pre-allocates space for a specified number of rows.
